_comment: MATCHED safety comparison vs our cell D1 (JOB_SPEC section 13). Scores the SAME 3,600 units as job-j8wgy (jobs/m2_first_cell hijack_eval @892bc6c: train.m2_gates hijack stage = hijack_subset(steer_dev of cohort v2, 8 x 45 clusters) x build_variants(hijack=all 5 HIJACK_TEMPLATES, d1=D1-A): 360 clean + 1,800 hijack + 1,440 D1-A) on Clef-flash then Clef 27B, through the Clef decide adapter (baselines.clef_backend + decide.Decider, clef_ssdm arm) on the FAST GDN path (accuracy-neutral: job-zfexa / job-t5yg2 reference-vs-fast argmax agreement 99.50 % / 99.80 %), then pairs per unit with D1's art-4naug rows (fetched from $D1_REF_URL, sha256 42c57b61..., checked with the unit set and D1's reproduction on CPU BEFORE any download; exit 21 = unit ids differ, fail closed). Primary eligibility for Clef - D1 = clean-correct in BOTH models (pre-declared); each model's own reference_y numbers and the D1-as-reference pair also reported. Pricing: job-sgihj per-row model 32 ms + 0.0399 ms/token at <= 1,000 tokens/unit (requests average 1,730 JSON chars) = 72 ms/unit -> Clef-flash 4.3 min + 0.6 load; Clef 27B at the 5.39x card ratio 23.3 + 1.6 load (job-d2u54 measured 2.373x: 10.3). Worst case (60 + 2 x 89) x 0.0495 = $11.78; expected 59 min = $2.92 (run only ~$1.93).

no_verdict_reason: measurement of two frozen external checkpoints on job-j8wgy's safety units, paired with D1's rows: rates and paired CIs are reported, nothing is promoted or selected; the unit-set / reproduction checks are fail-closed preconditions (exit 21), not a decision rule
pricing: jobs/clef_baseline/price.py: job-sgihj measured Clef-flash per-row rates; Clef planned at the card's 5.39x median-latency ratio (job-d2u54 measured fast-path ratio 2.373x is the expected case)

eligibility.primary: both: clean-correct in BOTH the Clef model and D1 (compare_arms eligibility='both'); steer_rate only
also: each model's own reference_y (own clean-correct; metrics.summarise)
reference_y with D1 as the reference (D1 clean-correct), as job-j8wgy's parent pairing
